steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Add the CYLINDER product and set its requested quantity to 10.
Complete the remaining pricing-sheet fields that the catalog can fill.
Use the product's Invite Vendor flow to add every available mapped QA vendor.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Open the published stage's Participants list to inspect the invited audience.
Assert that the published stage has at least one invited participant.
